videos.headline: Rome Odunze makes solid catch for Washington
videos.description: Michael Penix Jr. throws a 12-yard TD pass to Rome Odunze to start Washington off with the 7-0 lead.

videos.headline: Damien Martinez gets Oregon State on board with TD
videos.description: Damien Martinez runs in the end zone for a 3-yard touchdown to tie Oregon State with Washington 7-7.

videos.headline: Oregon State and Washington trade turnovers
videos.description: Oregon State recovers a Washington fumble, and on the next play Washington recovers the ball.

videos.headline: Michael Penix Jr. takes it in for 5-yard TD
videos.description: Michael Penix Jr. takes the ball in the end zone himself to get another touchdown for the Huskies.

videos.headline: Damien Martinez trucks defender to pick up first down
videos.description: Damien Martinez rolls through Washington's defense to pick up a first down for the Beavers.

videos.headline: Rome Odunze catches another dime from Penix
videos.description: Michael Penix Jr. throws a 32-yard touchdown pass to Rome Odunze.

videos.headline: Jabbar Muhammad grabs second INT
videos.description: Jabbar Muhammad has a second interception on the night, forcing the ball back to the Huskies.

videos.headline: Oregon State's Damien Martinez scores his 2nd TD of the game
videos.description: Damien Martinez scores on a 5-yard touchdown run, bringing back Oregon State within five points of Washington.

videos.headline: DJ Uiagalelei spins and jukes Huskies' defense
videos.description: DJ Uiagalelei takes it 26-yards up the field for the Beavers, using spin and juke moves to gain the first down.

videos.headline: Washington takes over after Oregon State can't convert on 4th down
videos.description: Oregon State comes up empty on a crucial fourth down late in the fourth quarter.
